sources.title: Context-level Language Modeling by Learning Predictive Context Embeddings
sources.snippet: The core of our model is a Context Predictor, a latent module trained to (i) encode preceding tokens into context embeddings, (ii) autoregressively forecast the embedding of the next context, and (iii) fuse this predictive context embedding back into the token-level decoding process.
